title: Two q-Deformations of Narayana Polynomials: Rogers Moments, Hankel Positivity, and q-Narayana Kernels
summary: We study two $q$-deformations of the continuous interpolation between type $B$ and shifted type $A$ Narayana polynomials, both constructed from the continuous $q$-ultraspherical (Rogers) functional. The first consists of affine moments of ordinary powers. For fixed $0 -1$, we prove total positivity of the kernel triangle by a Jackson $q$-Bessel--Edrei factorization and strict total positivity of its associated square by a discrete moment representation.
